name: 斩月
description: 对本棋子相邻的1个敌方棋子造成等同于本棋子攻击力的物理伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以斩月对' + target.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点物理伤害' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.floor((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: "选择相邻的1个敌方棋子，造成" + damage + '点物理伤害。', expectedValues: { damage: damage } }; }
